snippet.title: Greenhouse: Tidy Up! // Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/5146200/Greenhouse_Tidy_Up

Greenhouse: Tidy Up! is a cozy single-player simulation where you bring order to a messy greenhouse. Sort and place hundreds of flowers and plants, find the best way to organize everything, and compete with other players for the fastest time.

👥 Players: Single Player
🛠️ Developer: Pixel Puffs
📚 Publisher: Pixel Puffs
📅 Release Date: Sep 28, 2026
🎯 Genre: Casual, Indie, Simulation
